text:
maria: FYI i'm planning a canary to switch inference-gateway TLS from ALB-terminating -> NLB passthrough. Terraform PR ready: https://git.company/repo/pull/242. Quick sanity check on SecretBinding + fallback so we don't bring traffic down.

sam: link? put a short summary of what changes in the TF module.

maria: PR updates module.gateway: changes listener from alb_tls -> nlb_passthrough, adds gateway tls mode passthrough, and references existing infra cert via SecretBinding. Also adds a canary rollout policy (10%).

ben: two quick flags: 1) healthchecks change — passthrough means LB no longer terminates TLS so the LB healthcheck must be TCP/TLS to the nodeport or we need a sidecar to emulate HTTP probes. 2) probe port vs targetPort mismatch caused flakes last time. Verify service.targetPort matches container port and the readiness path.

zara: AWS NLB supports TCP and TLS checks. If you keep HTTP probes we need a termination point. Either a small termination proxy (sidecar) or change the AWS healthcheck to TCP on the nodePort. Which do you prefer for canary?

maria: leaning sidecar that terminates TLS for health only — less infra change. Secret will stay in infra-certs ns; plan to create a SecretBinding in gateway ns that references infra-certs/my-inference-cert. Any binding race conditions we should guard for?

len: we hit a race before: gateway attempted to bind before SecretBinding was ready and the controller dropped config briefly. Two mitigations: pre-create SecretBinding (TF) and block gateway resource apply until binding shows ready (we used a local-exec check). Or roll the gateway as a second step after SecretBinding apply.

ben: also add annotation to the Gateway for routing fallback. We have an infra routing policy that will automatically fail traffic back to the ALB-terminating variant on TLS handshake failures if the annotation redwood.io/tls-fallback=terminate is present. Otherwise you'll see connections time out with no automatic fallback.

sam: can you paste the gateway + secretbinding snippet you plan to apply?

maria: sure — current snippet in the PR: 
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.x-k8s.io/v1alpha1
kind: Gateway
metadata:
  name: inference-gateway
  namespace: gateway
  annotations:
    redwood.io/tls-fallback: "terminate"
spec:
  gatewayClassName: aws-nlb-passthrough
  listeners:
  - name: tls-443
    protocol: TLS
    port: 443
    tls:
      mode: Passthrough
---
apiVersion: security.x-k8s.io/v1alpha1
kind: SecretBinding
metadata:
  name: bind-inference-cert
  namespace: gateway
spec:
  secretRef:
    name: my-inference-cert
    namespace: infra-certs
```

maria: Terraform creates that SecretBinding before updating the Gateway resource. I'll add a small wait in the pipeline to confirm SecretBinding.status.ready == true.

zara: good. Add a smoke job that runs a TLS handshake + inference request against the canary endpoints (both model and health), and mark the canary as failed if average latency or error rate crosses threshold.

len: schedule wise — any objections to doing this at 6pm PST today? That gives ops time to watch metrics.

sam: lgtm from infra side, watch the probe semantics closely. Also add a rollback note in the PR (terraform target apply or revert commit).

maria: will update PR with: pre-create SecretBinding, pipeline check for ready, add smoke-test job, canary 10% -> 10m -> auto-fallback, rollback instructions. Scheduling for 6pm PST.

deploy-bot: Canary started for inference-gateway @ 2026-03-18T02:45:00Z (10% traffic) :rocket:

maria: monitoring logs + console now, will post short update after 15m. ping me if you see anything anomalous.

sam: if it flips unexpectedly, run:
```bash
# quick rollback via terraform
terraform apply -target=module.gateway -var-file=rollback.tfvars
```

maria: done — PR updated and notes added. thanks all :thumbsup:
